title: WelcomeMessage
description: A simple, customizable join server welcome message plugin.
body:
This is a very simple messaging plugin.

You can send a welcome message to players when they join the server.

Of course, this is customizable!

It is located at \plugins\WelcomeMessage\config.yml

Configuration as follows:

// 欢迎消息配置

// Welcome Message Configuration

// 支持 Minecraft 颜色代码（&符号），多行消息用 '-' 开头

// Supports Minecraft color codes (using & symbol), use '-' at the beginning for multiline messages

welcome-messages:
  - "&6欢迎加入服务器！"
  - "&eWelcome to the server!"

Attention! Tests that have been conducted show that the plugin only supports Paper 1.21-1.21.10, please test other server versions yourself.

If you have any better suggestions or feedback, feel free to contact me at xzm5749@163.com
